title: A flat point that is not a turning point
caption: dy/dx = eˣ(x − 1)²/(x² + 1)² is never negative: the curve only rises. At x = 1 the numerator (x − 1)² is zero, so the curve flattens at (1, e/2) for a moment and then carries on upwards.
alt: The curve y = eˣ/(x² + 1) rising from left to right with a momentary flat point at (1, e/2 ≈ 1.36).
description: Quotient rule with u = eˣ and v = x² + 1.
A square is never negative, so the gradient is ≥ 0 everywhere.
It is zero at x = 1, where the curve flattens but does not turn.
